note: Art packet for an act opening. Every layer is a GPT image render against the listed references; cutout layers were rendered on pure white, processed with tools/cutout.py and encoded to WebP. Layers with a "generator" field were applied later from owner-approved candidates (see "replaced" for the art they superseded).

layers.approved: 2026-11-18 by the owner, from the story art preview
layers.prompt: Backdrop layer for a layered paper-theatre story diorama. Match exactly the hand-painted paper look, aged cardstock texture, visible fibres, brushwork and muted storybook palette of the references. New place: a vast cavern deep below the mountains where an ancient stone city lies swallowed by rock, filling the entire image, flat front view: a rough layered rock ceiling, pale shafts of dusty light falling from cracks above, distant carved stone towers, arches, a broken stone bridge and house fronts half-buried in the cave walls, soft grey-green, ochre and moss tones, calm dusty stone floor across the lower 35%. No characters, text, frame, border or vignette; even neutral lighting.
layers.postprocessing: Already 1536x1024 (the backdrop size): no crop or resize; tools/encode.py (WebP quality 80).
layers.seedNote: the GPT image endpoint takes no seed; the raw render is the archive

layers.prompt: Single continuous hand-painted paper cutout on a plain flat pure white background, thin cream scissor-cut paper border around the whole silhouette, illustration not photograph, nothing cropped, no characters, no text, no ground shadow. Scene: a long timber hall facade with a green copper roof, two hanging deer banners, broad stone steps up to its door, flanking rune-stones.
